tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a FaceSign session including status, transcript, AI analysis, node reports, video AI analysis, and asynchronous analysis lifecycle states.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List FaceSign sessions with optional filtering by status, date range, and search term. Supports pagination via cursor.
